{"script":"# create initialization script
cat > init_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p logs
# Sample log files across different months
touch logs/2023-01-01.log
touch logs/2023-01-02.log
touch logs/2023-01-15.log
touch logs/2023-02-01.log
touch logs/2023-02-05.log
touch logs/2023-03-01.log
touch logs/2022-12-31.log
# some additional files that should not match other months
touch logs/2023-01-05.log
EOF
chmod +x init_logs.sh
# run initialization
./init_logs.sh
# create the counting script
cat > count_month_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: count_month_logs.sh YYYY-MM
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 YYYY-MM" >&2
  exit 2
fi
month="$1"
cd logs || { echo "logs directory not found" >&2; exit 1; }
shopt -s nullglob
files=( "$month"-*.log )
# Only count files that match the exact YYYY-MM-DD.log pattern
count=0
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  # basename
  name="$(basename "$f")"
  if [[ "$name" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.log$ ]]; then
    # verify the YYYY-MM part matches exactly
    if [[ "${name:0:7}" == "$month" ]]; then
      count=$((count+1))
    fi
  fi
done
echo "$count"
EOF
chmod +x count_month_logs.sh
# Run a quick verification for 2023-01
./count_month_logs.sh 2023-01
"}
